workspace.description: With repository, the workspace whose GitHub installation reaches it, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

agentId.description: A coding agent whose pull request it is, by its id as list_agents answered it; leave it out to name a repository's pull request instead.

repository.description: The pull request's repository, as owner/name, one the workspace's GitHub installation reaches, with number; leave it out with agentId.

number.description: The pull request's number: with repository, the one meant; with agentId, another pull request of the agent's repository, left out for the agent's own.

paths.description: The files, by their paths as read_pull_request's changes name them.

viewed.description: true to mark them viewed, false to unmark them.
